entities.summary: Kenneth Lovsin is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman who played in one National Hockey League game for the Washington Capitals during the 1990–91 NHL season against the Pittsburgh Penguins. He failed to register a point despite registering 2 shots and was -2 in the game.
